item.title: Trump rescinding rule incentivising EV production
item.description: WASHINGTON: The Trump administration said it is rescinding a rule that incentivised automakers to produce electric vehicles to meet fuel economy requirements by overstating energy savings. item.description: TOKYO: The new Toyota RAV4 PHEV (plug-in hybrid) is due to be launched in Japan on March 9, 2026 and further expands the 6th generation RAV4’s go-anywhere, do-anything spirit. item.title: Smaller bikes face bigger risks
item.description: PETALING JAYA: The kapchai, a humble, lightweight motorcycle commonly found on Malaysian roads, is the nation’s deadliest vehicle, accounting for nearly 70% of annual road fatalities.
